evals.prompt: Design Payload collections for products, categories, and category assignments where assignments need sort order and an operator note.
evals.expected_output: An explicit product-categories junction model with singular indexed parent relationships, relation metadata, compound uniqueness, ownership, joins only where needed, and a completed review rationale.
expectations: Models the metadata-bearing many-to-many relation as a junction collection.
Defines compound uniqueness and indexes without making each parent relation unique.
States deletion, access, scale, ordering, and inverse-navigation decisions.

evals.prompt: Model a self-referential organization hierarchy plus undirected peer relationships between organizations in Payload CMS.
evals.expected_output: A parent-owned tree relation with cycle prevention and a separate canonicalized peer junction that prevents A-B and B-A duplicates.
expectations: Uses a singular parent relation and optional children join for the hierarchy.
Prevents cycles and canonicalizes undirected peer pairs.
Defines compound uniqueness, indexes, deletion, and access policies.

evals.prompt: Review an order schema that stores customer and product relations on both sides, cascades payment deletion, and authorizes order-item junction writes from only the order parent.
evals.expected_output: A critical review that removes mirrored persistence, protects financial history, requires authorization through both junction parents, and replaces mutable-only historical data with snapshots.
expectations: Identifies mirrored relationships as duplicate sources of truth.
Rejects cascade deletion for payments and requires historical snapshots.
Requires junction authorization against both participating parents.

evals.prompt: Diagnose duplicate organization memberships created under concurrency even though a beforeChange hook checks whether the user and organization pair already exists.
evals.expected_output: A race-condition diagnosis that moves the invariant to a compound database unique constraint while retaining optional friendly hook validation.
expectations: Explains why an application-only duplicate check races.
Adds a compound unique constraint for user plus organization.
Covers migration cleanup, conflict handling, indexes, and transaction behavior.

evals.prompt: A Payload collection already has the right data model; fix only a custom Jalali date Admin component that fails to resolve through the package Import Map.
evals.expected_output: A boundary decision that does not redesign collections and routes the work to the field or Admin component integration workflow.
expectations: Recognizes that collection design is not the primary problem.
Preserves the existing schema and relationship model.
Routes diagnosis to component export and Import Map inspection.
